race.comment: Open race to close out the card. YES DONALD YES (7) hit the frame at the Sunny Coast when resuming and will have taken some benefit from that hit-out. Looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside and should prove very hard to toss. OUT OF LUCK (10) has placed over this track and trip and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Include with Thornton on board. LADY WINDERMERE (11) will be ready to peak now third run back from the break and maps nicely for this from gate six. Top-three conveyance. RED SAMOVAR (15) was a touch plain at the latest effort but go on the solid win two back. Worth another chance. HANG OUT (4) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be discounted lightly.
